object.attr: as implemented: limited to what the samples prove prints as typed. The MELLON-VER-STS sample prints ' as a closing quote (CF-P23), and runs of hyphens and other ASCII punctuation aren't in the samples, so they are MELLON-PDF-SRS-136's (decided on 2026-11-11). 0.3.0 fixed table rows starting with [ or *; test lines starting with * or [ after a line break too (CF-P24).
object.description: In a description, the exported PDF shall show each ASCII letter and digit, each of _ < > % & ~ @ = ( ) / : ; , . ! and a hyphen next to no other hyphen, as the document holds the character.
